data.credibility: Management guides clearly on margins and volume targets while maintaining them across quarters. However, they occasionally drop specific capex, subsidy, and long-term revenue targets when unmentioned in subsequent quarters, reflecting selective reporting of guidance.

lines.line: Capex target of INR140 crores for FY26 was dropped after being left unmentioned.
EBITDA margin range of 19% to 21% is on track, supported by 20.6% actual.
Expanded JKY Groove reach to 500 EBOs by April 2026 as promised.
Long-term revenue target of Rs. 8,000 crores by FY29 was dropped.
Subsidy realization of INR40 crores to INR50 crores in FY27 was dropped.
Marketing expenditure target of close to 5% remains on track.
Double-digit volume growth target for FY27 is on track and reiterated.
Network addition of 8,000 to 10,000 outlets by fiscal year-end is pending.

bull: Operating cash flow is robust at 107% of reported profit over 5 years, showing strong cash conversion.
EBITDA margin improved from 18.6% in FY21 to 22.0% in FY26, supporting reliable profitability.
The balance sheet is lightly geared with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.26 in FY26.
bear: Growth has slowed significantly, with revenue compounding at just 3.6% over three years compared to 13.1% over five.
Working-capital days have stretched unfavorably from 10 to 26 days over the past five years.
Borrowings increased threefold from INR127 crores in FY21 to INR396 crores in FY26.
